feature_name: Fix codegen backend optional nested field handling
description: Update the codegen backend to properly handle optional nested fields in unions. Currently, the backend only processes the first nested type and returns early, causing runtime TypeErrors when None values are encountered. Implement comprehensive type checking for all union members and add appropriate fallback logic.
functional_requirements: Generate isinstance checks for all nested types within a union, not just the first one
Add a final else clause to handle any remaining cases that don't match the specific type checks
Ensure the behavior matches the non-codegen backend's handling of optional nested fields
Maintain backward compatibility with existing code generation patterns
